payload.text: **Confirm the Tactile install hint's URL live** (issue 0014). Plain DNS for extensions.gnome.org fails from here: on 16 Oct it resolved on neither rhadamanth nor kovacs, and timed out when rhadamanth asked 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 directly, though both answer github.com; Cloudflare's DNS over HTTPS answers it (54.221.220.94, TTL 60). From another network, `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' 'https://extensions.gnome.org/download-extension/tactile@lundal.io.shell-extension.zip?shell_version=50.1'` should give a 302 to a versioned zip. Here it needs `--resolve extensions.gnome.org:443:<address>`, which Claude Code's auto-mode classifier refused to vc, so it is hv's to run.
